text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! Epiphaneia's looking in top shape! Does this make her the top favorite for next year's Classics!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you're jumping the gun way too fast!
Well, still... she definitely seems to have the talent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia made a magnificent debut.
The sheer sharpness bursting from her immense power astonished me all over again, even as her Trainer.
choice_data_list: (And most importantly, she didn't lose control...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was worried she might sprint off recklessly once the voice of destiny pushed her...
but she finished the race safely, allowing me to breathe a sigh of relief.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
How was I?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Right!
I could totally feel everyone getting hyped up too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Racing really is so much fun♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Epi-saaan!
That was a magnificent run...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"As a reporter, I've witnessed many
debut races, but...
I felt top-notch potential in you!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"With things turning out like this,
expectations for next year are skyrocketing...!
Have you decided on your next race yet?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Of course it's settled!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer!
choice_data_list: (Wait, we haven't even talked about that yet, have we...!?)
(Wait, we haven't even talked about that yet, right...!?)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong?
Tell me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gazed at so directly, my mind races.
With her caliber, she should be able to challenge the very top right now.
Which means the best choice is a Junior-tier GⅠ race—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's right!!
I'm heading for the Hopeful Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! So you're taking the royal road!
What lies beyond that must be... I can't wait!
I'll keep my eyes on you, Epi-san!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, keep your eyes on me!
Alright, let's head back!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So, so, so, so looooong!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Golshi! You came to celebrate
my debut too, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for going out of your way!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No way!
Golshi-chan's race is coming up next, remember?!
In the main event, yo!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's a sashimi conveyor belt race!!
I, and I alone, shall be crowned this year's King of Chrysanthemum Garnishing!
choice_data_list: What kind of race is that?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oyo? It's not there? The andante?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Fine then, Epi!
I challenge you to a runaway face-off!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like you're having fun!
Alright, bring it on!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What did you say!?
Golshi-chan ain't no fish!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Even if unruffled, pantaloons!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Then I'll chase after them!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a deft motion, Gold Ship dropped something.
Written upon it was a single word—
"Chief."
choice_data_list: ...Ah, I've got to chase after her!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Following after Epiphaneia, I found that Cesario and the others had already caught her. It seems Gold Ship had already made her escape...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I was surprised. You were still wearing your racing silks, Epi...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind that!
How was it, my Make Debut?!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, you were amazing.
I'm so glad your debut went off without a hitch."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —That was a great run.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: But—the real deal starts now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her words tighten my resolve. It's true, a debut is merely the beginning. From here on out, only a tiny handful will ever stand at the top.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "If it's you... I know you'll be completely fine."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're totally right!
Of course I believe in you too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"The voice of destiny says so too!
It says that I'll—definitely be fine!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Gently draping a blanket over her so as not to wake her, I ponder to myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like Symboli Kris S said,
the real challenge starts now. Today, honestly,
Epiphaneia fought purely on raw potential alone...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... there is a concern.
That "Voice of Destiny" she mentioned.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was fine today, but if cheering voices push her forward,
she'll go sprinting off in an instant...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I recall the final showdown against Symboli Kris S,
right after signing our trainer contract. We splendidly
aligned the voice of fate with our own—
choice_data_list: (I haven't been able to reproduce it since then, though...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I can unleash it on command,
I'll be able to guide Epiphaneia properly.
First, let's figure out how to do it.
